presetTierNote: A small handful of cards are seeded into the deck at launch already sitting above Common — at Rare, Epic, Legendary, or Mythic — bypassing the Common-start / $5-base rule entirely. Which cards those are, which tier each starts at, and their launch values, live on the individual card entries (isPreset: true, originTier set to whatever tier they launched at).
moveRule: Each quarter, check every card's buys and sales counters against its current tier's number in moveThresholds. Whichever counter reaches that number first decides the move: buys reaching it first moves the card up one tier, sales reaching it first moves the card down one tier. Common is the floor and Mythic is the ceiling — neither can be crossed. After any move, both counters reset to 0 and the race restarts at the new tier.
